Bottom-sheet details are copied from the updated Android style guide (version 1795459789-4808, project/5-controls.md), which Rajal says carries these answers.
source: Rajal Patel, DREAMT-4719 comment 276938, 2026-11-23; Android style guide 1795459789-4808 (still android-tribpub 1cfb069a6; markets.json unchanged)

alerts_enable_fill.answer: The export is right and the guide was wrong: the default in main is #FF6859, but 75 of 77 markets set their own Alerts_Enable_Button_Background
alerts_enable_fill.note: '#DAA520 in 17' in the comment counts the two markets whose action is also #DAA520; the guide's 15 leaves them in the 58

account_bottom_sheets.answer: Not Material: the two account bottom sheets (Manage subscription and Delete account) are inflated with the application context, which drops the app theme, so their buttons are plain framework buttons in the device default style (SettingsFragment.java:608, 651)
account_bottom_sheets.label: Roboto Medium 14sp on stock Android (OEM fonts may differ), sentence case

login_link.answer: Drawn in the color resource link, underlined (PaywallManagerImpl.java:165), on the white paywall screen (fragment_paywall_purchase.xml); Paywall_LoginButton_Text is not used by any code

dark_mode.answer: Only the web views, Your News topics and the pop-up dialogs in Settings are different
dark_mode.style_guide: From code, not checked on a device: Settings dialogs without their own style use Material 3 dark dialog colors; web views set no background (dark window while loading; pages with prefers-color-scheme dark render dark); Auth0 login follows the browser; in CT, DP, HC, MC, NYDN, TOD and VP the Settings screen sets no white window background. Splash and Your News onboarding force light. No user toggle. values-night changes only the widget colors.
dark_mode.our_reading: Every screen the design system covers is light only on both apps; only views drawn by the system or by web content can go dark.

icon_vector_masters.reading: No vector masters exist on Android either (iOS: none, 2026-11-18).

amazon_signin.reading: ic_amazon is never shown; the style guide moved it to Remove.

not_answered: Savings label font, size and padding (5.6, second half of b)
